expectations.text: Advises against the reflexive smart/dumb/styles 3-way split
expectations.evidence: "don't do the three-way smart/dumb/styles split here. At 180 lines this is one coherent concern"

expectations.text: Recommends extracting a hook (abstraction) instead of splitting container/view files
expectations.evidence: "reach for an abstraction, not a file split... a natural custom hook: const { savedCards, values, setValue, submit, status } = useCheckoutForm()"

expectations.text: Notes ~180 lines is acceptable as one cohesive file (raised size threshold)
expectations.evidence: "Leave it as one file for now. 180 lines of cohesive checkout logic is comfortably within the range an agent handles well."

expectations.text: Grounds advice in AI agents' reluctance to read adjacent files / cross-file context cost
expectations.evidence: "An AI agent doesn't — it works with the file in front of it and is genuinely reluctant to go open adjacent files"; "doubled the cross-file lookups the agent won't perform."
